Subject: Your wrongful termination matter

Dear Mr. Gokhale,

Thank you for meeting us on 11 April 2024 about your dispute with Everest Pharma Ltd. As we understand it, the employer offered to settle.

Our advice is to negotiate a settlement of gratuity and notice pay. Please collect the salary slips and the gratuity calculation and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
